en.blurb_leader: %{name} is the monarch of %{clan}. The guardianship of all Clan cats has been entrusted to them by StarClan. The monarch is the highest authority in the Clan. The monarch holds Clan meetings, determines mentors for new trainees, and names new knights. To help them protect the Clan, StarClan has given them nine lives. They typically take the suffix "crown".
en.blurb_deputy: %{name} is %{clan}'s viceroy. The viceroy is the second in command, just below the monarch. They advise the monarch and organize daily patrols, alongside normal knight duties. Typically, a viceroy is personally appointed by the current monarch. As dictated by the Warrior Code, all viceroys must train at least one trainee before appointment. The viceroy succeeds the monarch if they die or retire.
en.blurb_warrior: %{name} is a knight. Knights are adult cats who feed and protect their Clan. They are trained to hunt and fight in addition to the ways of the Warrior Code. Knights are essential to the survival of a Clan, and usually make up the bulk of its members.
en.blurb_elder: %{name} is an elder. They have spent many moons serving their Clan, and have earned many moons of rest. Elders are essential to passing down the oral tradition of the Clan. Sometimes, cats may retire due to disability or injury. Whatever the circumstance of their retirement, elders are held in high esteem in the Clan and always eat before warriors and healers.
en.blurb_medicine_cat: %{name} is a apothecary. Apothecarys are the healers of the Clan. They treat injuries and illnesses with herbal remedies. Unlike knights, apothecarys are not expected to hunt and fight for the Clan. In addition to their healing duties, apothecarys also have a special connection to StarClan. Every half-moon, they travel to their Clan's holy place to commune with StarClan.
en.blurb_mediator: %{name} is a mediator. Mediators are not typically required to hunt or fight for the Clan. Rather, mediators are charged with handling disagreements between Clanmates and disputes between Clans. Some mediators train as apprentices to serve their Clan, while others may choose to become mediators later in life.
en.blurb_queen: %{name} is a nurturer. While many cats will choose to raise kittens of their own during the course of their life, some choose to dedicate themselves to nurturing all the Clan's kits as well as helping parents through pregnancy and the raising of their own kits.
en.blurb_apprentice: %{name} is an trainee, in training to become a knight. Kits can be made knight trainees at six moons of age, where they will learn how to hunt and fight for their Clan. Typically, the training of a trainee is entrusted to a single knight — their mentor. To build character, trainees are often assigned the unpleasant and grunt tasks of Clan life. Trainees usually take the suffix "-paw", to represent the path their paws take towards adulthood.
en.blurb_medcat_app: %{name} is a apothecary trainee, training to become a full apothecary. Kits can be made apothecary trainees at six moons of age, where they will learn how to heal their Clanmates and commune with StarClan. Apothecary trainees are typically chosen for their interest in healing and/or their connecting to StarClan. Trainees usually take the suffix "-paw", to represent the path their paws take towards adulthood.
en.blurb_mediator_app: %{name} is a mediator trainee, training to become a full mediator. Mediators are in charge of handling disagreements both within the Clan and between Clans. Mediator trainees are often chosen for their quick thinking and steady personality. Trainees usually take the suffix "-paw", to represent the path their paws take towards adulthood.
en.blurb_queen_app: %{name} is a nurturer trainee, training to become a full nurturer. Nurturers help nurture all the Clan's kits as well as helping parents through parenthood. Nurturer trainees are often chosen for their patient nature and interest in helping around the nursery. Trainees usually take the suffix "-paw", to represent the path their paws take towards adulthood.
en.blurb_kitten: %{name} is a kitten. All cats below the age of six moons are considered kits. Kits are prohibited from leaving camp in order to protect them from the dangers of the wild. Although they don't have any official duties in the Clan, they are expected to learn the legends and traditions of their Clan. They are protected by every cat in the Clan and always eat first. Kits usually take the suffix "-kit".
en.blurb_newborn: %{name} is a newborn kitten. All cats below the age of six moons are considered kits. Kits are prohibited from leaving camp in order to protect them from the dangers of the wild. Although they don't have any official duties in the Clan, they are expected to learn the legends and traditions of their Clan. They are protected by every cat in the Clan and always eat first. Kits usually take the suffix "-kit".
en.blurb_unknown: %{name} has an unknown rank. I guess they want to make their own way in life!
